sources.title: Trusted publishing for npm packages
claims: Trusted publishing requires an exact workflow trust relationship and id-token: write
npm CLI 11.5.1 or later and Node 22.14.0 or later are required
GitHub-hosted trusted publishing generates npm provenance automatically for public packages in public repositories

sources.title: Staged publishing for npm packages
claims: npm stage publish separates upload from a later human 2FA approval
Staging requires npm CLI 11.15.0 or later
Only an already-existing package can be staged

sources.title: npm stage command
claims: npm stage is workspace-unaware
The selected tag is immutable for a staged package
private packages are refused rather than staged

sources.title: Changesets release action
claims: The action can maintain a version PR or invoke a repository-defined publish command
Custom publish logic must explicitly tolerate versions that already exist after prior or partial publication

sources.title: Changesets prereleases
claims: Prerelease mode should normally run on a branch separate from the default branch
The prerelease identifier also becomes the npm dist-tag
A first publish of a brand-new package can still acquire latest despite prerelease mode

sources.title: Changesets configuration options
claims: private: true is the durable way to prevent package publication
linked groups share a version but do not force every member to publish on every release

sources.title: Using artifact attestations to establish provenance for builds
claims: Non-npm binary provenance requires attestations: write and id-token: write
An attestation binds an artifact digest to workflow provenance but does not validate product behavior

sources.title: cargo publish
claims: cargo publish --dry-run performs packaging and verification without upload
Cargo publication can be restricted or disabled by manifest metadata

sources.title: Automated publishing of packages to pub.dev
claims: pub.dev supports OIDC-based GitHub Actions publishing only for existing packages
GitHub Actions publication must be triggered by a matching pushed tag

sources.title: Prometheus v3 release contract
claims: The stable artifact set, registry decisions, and publication conditions are machine-readable
Publication is a distinct completion dimension and remains unauthorized during the RC change
